item.p: Specifications: EXPath Binary Module 4.0, as the QT4 bin- sets test it (namespace http://expath.org/ns/binary; the bin: functions and their errors bin:differing-length-arguments, bin:index-out-of-range, bin:negative-size, bin:octet-out-of-range, bin:non-numeric-character, bin:unknown-encoding, bin:conversion-error, bin:unknown-significance-order).
Unlocks: 673 (XP40 and XQ40), in 39 bin- sets.
Replaces: the functions are absent (XPST0017), and supports-binary-library is false.

Mechanism: a function-library part of its own over xs:base64Binary items (src/function_library_binary.c). Encodings go through the existing decoders (src/xml_encoding.c, ), and number packing through the decimal and double code of src/cast.c.
Header: none (with option 2: one feature function).

Gate: ≥ 95 % of the 673. Done 2026-10-19 (): bin-* 646 of 646 in XP40 and XQ40 (26 wrong error codes, XPTY0004 by the 4.0 types); fn-serialize +24 in each; the 673 also counted fn-serialize's and fn-system-properties' binary cases.
